title: Viral Omelette Toasted Sandwich
description: A protein-packed, quick-to-make toasted sandwich featuring eggs, mozzarella, Parma ham, and fresh spinach.
steps: Add the olive oil to a non-stick pan on high heat
Cut both slices of bread in half diagonally and add to the pan
Whisk 3 eggs and fresh parsley before adding to pan in the gaps between the bread
Allow whisked eggs to cook, then flip over to toast the bread
At this point add the slices of cheese, Parma ham and spinach
Flip in half and cook for a further 2-3 mins
